ai.chooseToolHint: Cut out a subject, erase something, change the background, and more.
ai.paidNote: Every AI tool is a paid call. Select a picture layer first for everything except creating a new picture.

form.alreadyShape: The picture is already {aspect}. Choose another shape.
form.noDescription: This AI service continues the scene on its own; it does not take a description.
form.marginHelp: Pixels of the picture itself, at most {max} per side{capped, select, yes { (the most this AI service adds to one side)} other {}}. For a bigger change, use Fit a shape.
form.waitNote: This can take up to 90 seconds. Please keep this page open.

subjects.label: People and objects (optional)
subjects.hint: Show a person or an object from this project's Avatars tab. Up to {max}, one person at most.
subjects.unsupported: The AI model set up for this tool cannot be shown people or objects, so none are used.
subjects.unsupportedModels: The AI model set up for this tool cannot be shown people or objects, so none are used. These models can: {models}.
subjects.stale: Untick the person or object that cannot be used.
subjects.otherService: A picture that shows a person or an object of this project is made by another AI service. Choose one to see whether it can run here.

aiPicker.title: Choose an AI tool
aiPicker.intro: Each tool is a paid AI call. Its result is added as a new layer, so your picture underneath is never changed.
aiPicker.notSetUp: Not set up in this workspace

reference.title: Reference pictures (optional)
reference.help: Pictures of the person or thing the change is about. The AI sees them in this order, so “the second picture” means the second one here. Leave the list empty to edit by description alone.
reference.full: That is as many as the AI takes: {max}. Remove one to add another.
reference.noneInProject: No pictures in this project yet
reference.allAdded: Every picture here is already added
reference.choose: Choose a picture from this project

text.hint: Add text, or select a text layer to change its words, font, colour, outline and shadow. With the Text tool you can also click on the picture to place it.
text.decorationHint: On for new text so it stays easy to read on any picture. Turn it off for plain text.

graphic.queuedChange: Your change is on its way. The new version replaces this graphic when it is ready.
graphic.queuedNew: Your graphic is on its way. It appears as a new layer when it is ready.
graphic.intro: A design takes a few minutes. You can keep editing meanwhile: the graphic appears as a new layer, with a transparent background, when it is ready.
graphic.whatChangePlaceholder: Make it red, add a thin white outline, say 50% instead
graphic.describePlaceholder: A bold yellow price tag that says “-50%”, slightly tilted

export.overTwoMb: Even the lowest quality is over 2 MB. Try a smaller canvas size.
export.sizeFailed: The size could not be worked out. Try again.
export.exportFailed: The picture could not be exported.
export.avifUnsupported: Your browser cannot make AVIF files. Choose WebP for a small file instead.
export.title: Export your picture
export.estimateUnknown: The file size could not be worked out.
export.aiLabelNote: This picture shows an avatar, so the exported file gets a small “AI-generated” label in the bottom-right corner.

canvas.refitQuestion: What should happen to what is already on the picture?
canvas.fitHint: Scales and centres every layer into the new shape. One undo puts it all back.
canvas.keepHint: Layers stay where they are; anything outside the frame is cut from the export.
canvas.sizeLineCustom: {size} pixels, custom shape. Pick a shape to use these sizes.
canvas.tooLarge: A picture this large may not open on some phones.
canvas.limits: {min} to {max} pixels on each side. When the shape changes you choose whether your layers fit the new shape or keep their positions.

arrange.proportion: Width and height keep the picture in proportion.
arrange.chooseLayer: Choose a layer to place it by number.
arrange.spreadSidewaysTip: Spread out sideways (3 or more layers)
arrange.spreadUpDownTip: Spread out up and down (3 or more layers)
arrange.cropMergeHint: Crop hides the outside of a picture without throwing it away, so you can widen it later. Merge turns the ticked layers into one new layer. Undo reverses either.

messages.cropped: Cropped. The whole picture is kept, so you can widen the crop later. Undo puts it back.
messages.chooseTwo: Choose at least two visible layers to merge.
messages.merged: Merged into one layer. Undo brings the separate layers back.
messages.mergeFailed: The layers could not be merged.
messages.layersDeleted: Layers deleted. Undo brings them back.
messages.layerDeleted: Layer deleted. Undo brings it back.
